statement: FlashAttention2 was not evaluated because the shared A800 software stack could not provide the cuDNN ABI required to build/import flash-attn. The installed nvidia-cudnn-cu12==8.9.7.29 ships split component libraries (libcudnn_ops_infer.so.8 etc.) but torch 2.2.0+cu121 links against the combined libcudnn.so.8. Without root access to install system-level cuDNN, the flash-attn wheel could not be built despite two bounded attempts.

attempts.error: pip metadata hook ran in isolated subprocess, could not find libcudnn.so.8
torch import failed: ImportError: libcudnn.so.8: cannot open shared object file

environment.missing: combined libcudnn.so.8 with SONAME and symbol version tags

note: B0 (BF16+Eager) and D1 (FP32+Eager) both confirmed working. Eager attention used for both profiles; Flash2 not silently substituted.
